title.narrative: Eliminating child labour and forced labour in the cotton, textile, garment value chains: an integrated approach.

description.narrative: Enhancing national legislation and policies, addressing basic needs and rights of children engaged or at risk of child labour, and of victims of forced labour, adopting an integrated area based approach that is embedded in a value chain intervention including cooperation with local industry and international buyers. Activities include strengthening enforcement of laws prohibiting child labour and forced labour, improving access to education, social protection and improving livelihoods.
